hero.copy: Launch location-targeted campaigns across a network of moving digital screens — with measurable delivery and GPS-linked reporting.
hero.imageAlt: A black Mercedes on the Beirut corniche carrying an AdzOnRoad digital advertising screen mounted along its roof

about.copy: AdzOnRoad turns everyday vehicle movement into a new channel for digital outdoor advertising.
about.statementCopy: Your campaign moves with participating vehicles instead of remaining fixed to one location.
about.movingCoverageBody: Campaign delivery moves through the city with participating vehicles.
about.recordedDeliveryBody: Ad plays contribute toward a measurable campaign delivery target.

cta.copy: Launch your campaign across AdzOnRoad’s moving screen network and track delivery as it happens.

footer.tagline: Moving digital advertising, built for Lebanon’s roads.

journeys.adv1Body: Choose your ad-play target, campaign period and creative.
journeys.adv2Body: Select your target regions and vehicle network.
journeys.adv3Body: Track campaign progress as your purchased ad plays are delivered.
journeys.drv1Body: Register yourself and your eligible vehicle.
journeys.drv2Body: AdzOnRoad installs and connects the advertising screen.
journeys.drv3Body: Drive normally and earn additional income from eligible active driving.

audiences.advBody: Build campaigns around ad plays, coverage and campaign periods.
audiences.partnerBody: Join individually or connect eligible vehicles from your fleet.

fleet.p1Body: Create additional earning potential from participating vehicles.
fleet.p2Body: AdzOnRoad manages screen installation, platform connectivity and advertising operations.
fleet.p3Body: Monitor participating vehicles, activity and earnings from one place.

builder.step1Note: Each ad play is one 15-second playback of your creative on a vehicle screen.
builder.step2Note: More vehicles distribute your campaign across a wider moving network and can help deliver the campaign target faster.
builder.step3Note: Beirut covers Hamra, Achrafieh, Downtown, Verdun, Gemmayze and Saifi. Greater Beirut adds Mount Lebanon and Jounieh.

fleetSec.body: AdzOnRoad equips eligible vehicles with digital advertising screens and manages the advertising network while your fleet continues doing what it already does — driving.
fleetSec.largeFleet: Have a large fleet? Contact us for a tailored partnership.

coverageSec.targetable: Campaigns can be targeted at these areas when you build a campaign.
coverageSec.expanding: AdzOnRoad’s network is expanding based on advertiser and fleet demand.
coverageSec.notTargetable: Not part of the targetable network yet. The network expands with advertiser and fleet demand.

builderSec.pricedNote: Priced per campaign against your delivery target, network size and regions. Confirmed with the team before a campaign is approved.

why.fixedBillboardBody: One location for the whole campaign period.
why.adzScreenBody: Many locations across that same period.
why.verifyBody: Campaign playback is connected with location and timestamp data, creating a measurable record of delivery.
why.targetBody: Choose the regions, vehicles and campaign parameters that match your advertising strategy.
why.measureBody: Track campaign progress, display activity and recorded delivery from one place.

earnings.premiumCheck: I regularly drive in premium areas
earnings.premiumAreas: Verdun · Gemmayzeh · Saifi · Downtown · other eligible areas

contactSec.title: Let’s build something that moves.
contactSec.body: Tell us what you’re looking to achieve and we’ll connect you with the right person.
contactSec.privacy: We’ll only use your details to respond to your inquiry.

login.footerCopy: Moving digital advertising, designed around the city.

forgot.brandCopy: Account recovery is handled securely by the AdzOnRoad team.
forgot.footerCopy: Moving digital advertising, designed around the city.
forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Contact our team and we’ll help you securely regain access to your AdzOnRoad account.
forgot.secureRecoveryBody1: For your security, password recovery is currently handled directly by the AdzOnRoad team.
forgot.secureRecoveryBody2: Once your identity is confirmed, you’ll receive temporary access and create a new password when you sign in.
forgot.contactSupportBody: Get in touch with our team to recover your account.
forgot.neverAsk: AdzOnRoad will never ask you to send your existing password by email.
forgot.adminNote: Administrators: your password is reset by another administrator in your organisation, from Settings → Users.
